title.en: An Act Establishing a Public High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Public High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Trường Trung học Công lập tại Barangay Poblacion, Đô thị Pangantucan, Tỉnh Bukidnon, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาสาธารณะ ในบารังไกย์ Poblacion เทศบาล Pangantucan จังหวัด Bukidnon และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Sekolah Menengah Negeri di Barangay Poblacion, Kotamadya Pangantucan, Provinsi Bukidnon, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Sekolah Menengah Awam di Barangay Poblacion, Perbandaran Pangantucan, Wilayah Bukidnon, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: A public high school in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Pangantucan, Province of Bukidnon, shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
